entities.summary: Yohji Yamamoto is a Japanese fashion designer based in Tokyo and Paris. He is considered a master tailor, alongside those such as Madeleine Vionnet, and is best known for his avant-garde tailoring featuring Japanese design aesthetics. Yohji Yamamoto was a architects & designers from Tokyo (b. 1943-10-03, Tokyo). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
